newsitem.title: USA: U.S. April leading index posts first fall in a year.
newsitem.headline: U.S. April leading index posts first fall in a year.

text.p: A key gauge of national economic activity posted its first drop in more than a year during April, the Conference Board said on Tuesday, a sign of potentially slower growth in coming months.

The Index of Leading Indicators, which is supposed to forecast economic trends six to nine months ahead, fell by 0.1 percent in April -- its first decline since a 0.7 percent fall in January 1996 -- after a revised 0.2 percent rise in March.
